snippet.title: Vultures: Scavengers of Death - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description: Vultures: Scavengers of Death is available now on PC. Watch the Vultures: Scavengers of Death launch trailer for this tactical turn-based survival horror, inspired by 90's survival horror classics. The new trailer showcases exploration, gameplay, and the nightmare that awaits. As an operative, scavenge the infested metropolis for materials and information that could cure the infection plaguing the world.
